===== FILE: examples/fetch-insights.ts =====

/**
 * Fetch account insights and media insights from the Instagram Graph API.
 * Generated: 2026-10-13
 * Env: IG_USER_ID, ACCESS_TOKEN, GRAPH_HOST (default https://graph.facebook.com), GRAPH_VERSION (default v25.0), MEDIA_ID (optional)
 * Run: npx tsx fetch-insights.ts
 */

const VERSION = process.env.GRAPH_VERSION ?? "v25.0";
const BASE = `https://graph.facebook.com/${VERSION}`;
const IG_USER_ID = process.env.IG_USER_ID!;
const TOKEN = process.env.ACCESS_TOKEN!;

async function get<T>(path: string): Promise<T> {
  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}${path}`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}` },
  });
  const json = (await res.json()) as T & { error?: { message: string } };
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json.error?.message ?? `HTTP ${res.status}`);
  return json;
}

async function main() {
  const account = await get<{ data: unknown[] }>(
    `/${IG_USER_ID}/insights?metric=reach,views,accounts_engaged&period=day`,
  );
  console.log("Account insights:", JSON.stringify(account.data, null, 2));

  const mediaId = process.env.MEDIA_ID;
  if (mediaId) {
    const media = await get<{ data: unknown[] }>(
      `/${mediaId}/insights?metric=views,reach,saved,shares`,
    );
    console.log("Media insights:", JSON.stringify(media.data, null, 2));
  }
}

main().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });


===== FILE: examples/lib.ts =====

/**
 * Minimal typed Graph client shared by examples/ (fetch, no SDK).
 * Env: GRAPH_HOST (default https://graph.facebook.com), GRAPH_VERSION (default v25.0), ACCESS_TOKEN
 */

const BASE = `${process.env.GRAPH_HOST ?? "https://graph.facebook.com"}/${process.env.GRAPH_VERSION ?? "v25.0"}`;
const TOKEN = process.env.ACCESS_TOKEN!;

interface GraphErrorBody {
  error?: { message: string; code: number; error_subcode?: number; fbtrace_id?: string };
}

export async function gget<T>(path: string): Promise<T> {
  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}${path}`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}` },
  });
  const json = (await res.json()) as T & GraphErrorBody;
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = new Error(`GET ${path} → ${json.error?.code}: ${json.error?.message ?? res.status}`) as Error & { code?: number };
    err.code = json.error?.code;
    throw err;
  }
  return json;
}

export async function gpost<T>(path: string, body: Record<string, string> = {}): Promise<T> {
  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}${path}`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body: new URLSearchParams({ ...body, access_token: TOKEN }),
  });
  const json = (await res.json()) as T & GraphErrorBody;
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = new Error(`POST ${path} → ${json.error?.code}: ${json.error?.message ?? res.status}`) as Error & { code?: number };
    err.code = json.error?.code;
    throw err;
  }
  return json;
}

export async function gpostJson<T>(path: string, body: unknown): Promise<T> {
  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}${path}`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}` },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  const json = (await res.json()) as T & GraphErrorBody;
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = new Error(`POST ${path} → ${json.error?.code}: ${json.error?.message ?? res.status}`) as Error & { code?: number };
    err.code = json.error?.code;
    throw err;
  }
  return json;
}

const RETRYABLE = new Set([1, 2, 4, 17, 32]);

export async function withRetry<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, tries = 5): Promise<T> {
  let delay = 1000;
  for (let i = 0; ; i++) {
    try {
      return await fn();
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      const code = (e as { code?: number })?.code;
      if (i >= tries - 1 || (code !== undefined && !RETRYABLE.has(code))) throw e;
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, delay + Math.random() * 250));
      delay *= 2;
    }
  }
}


===== FILE: examples/publish-photo.ts =====

/**
 * Publish a single photo to Instagram via the Graph API (two-step flow).
 * Generated: 2026-10-13
 * Env: IG_USER_ID, ACCESS_TOKEN (Page token), GRAPH_VERSION (default v21.0), IMAGE_URL, CAPTION
 * Run: npx tsx publish-photo.ts
 */

const VERSION = process.env.GRAPH_VERSION ?? "v21.0";
const BASE = `https://graph.facebook.com/${VERSION}`;
const IG_USER_ID = process.env.IG_USER_ID!;
const TOKEN = process.env.ACCESS_TOKEN!;

async function post<T>(path: string, body: Record<string, string>): Promise<T> {
  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}${path}`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body: new URLSearchParams({ ...body, access_token: TOKEN }),
  });
  const json = (await res.json()) as T & { error?: { message: string } };
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json.error?.message ?? `HTTP ${res.status}`);
  return json;
}

async function main() {
  // Step 1: create the media container
  const container = await post<{ id: string }>(`/${IG_USER_ID}/media`, {
    image_url: process.env.IMAGE_URL ?? "https://example.com/photo.jpg",
    caption: process.env.CAPTION ?? "Hello from the API #launch",
  });
  console.log("Container:", container.id);

  // Step 2: publish it
  const published = await post<{ id: string }>(`/${IG_USER_ID}/media_publish`, {
    creation_id: container.id,
  });
  console.log("Published media ID:", published.id);
}

main().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });


===== FILE: examples/publish-reel.ts =====

/**
 * Publish a Reel: create a REELS container, poll until FINISHED, then publish.
 * Generated: 2026-10-13
 * Env: IG_USER_ID, ACCESS_TOKEN (Page token), GRAPH_VERSION (default v21.0), VIDEO_URL, CAPTION
 * Run: npx tsx publish-reel.ts
 */

const VERSION = process.env.GRAPH_VERSION ?? "v21.0";
const BASE = `https://graph.facebook.com/${VERSION}`;
const IG_USER_ID = process.env.IG_USER_ID!;
const TOKEN = process.env.ACCESS_TOKEN!;

async function post<T>(path: string, body: Record<string, string>): Promise<T> {
  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}${path}`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body: new URLSearchParams({ ...body, access_token: TOKEN }),
  });
  const json = (await res.json()) as T & { error?: { message: string } };
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json.error?.message ?? `HTTP ${res.status}`);
  return json;
}

async function containerStatus(id: string) {
  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}/${id}?fields=status_code,status&access_token=${TOKEN}`);
  const json = (await res.json()) as { status_code: string; status?: string; error?: { message: string } };
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json.error?.message ?? `HTTP ${res.status}`);
  return json;
}

async function main() {
  const container = await post<{ id: string }>(`/${IG_USER_ID}/media`, {
    media_type: "REELS",
    video_url: process.env.VIDEO_URL ?? "https://example.com/reel.mp4",
    caption: process.env.CAPTION ?? "New reel",
    share_to_feed: "true",
  });
  console.log("Container:", container.id);

  // Poll every 5s until processed (videos are async)
  for (;;) {
    const s = await containerStatus(container.id);
    console.log("Status:", s.status_code);
    if (s.status_code === "FINISHED") break;
    if (s.status_code === "ERROR" || s.status_code === "EXPIRED") {
      throw new Error(`Container ${s.status_code}: ${s.status ?? "unknown"}`);
    }
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 5000));
  }

  const published = await post<{ id: string }>(`/${IG_USER_ID}/media_publish`, {
    creation_id: container.id,
  });
  console.log("Published Reel media ID:", published.id);
}

main().catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });

===== FILE: examples/webhook-handler.ts =====

/**
 * Instagram webhook receiver: verification (GET) + signed event intake (POST).
 * Generated: 2026-10-13
 * Env: PORT (default 3000), WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN, APP_SECRET
 * Run: npx tsx webhook-handler.ts  (expose via ngrok/cloudflared for Meta to reach it)
 *
 * Uses only node:http — no framework dependency.
 */
import { createHmac, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto";
import { createServer, IncomingMessage, ServerResponse } from "node:http";

const VERIFY_TOKEN = process.env.WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN ?? "";
const APP_SECRET = process.env.APP_SECRET ?? "";
const seen = new Set<string>(); // replace with Redis/DB in production

function validSignature(raw: Buffer, header: string | undefined): boolean {
  if (!header?.startsWith("sha256=") || !APP_SECRET) return false;
  const expected = createHmac("sha256", APP_SECRET).update(raw).digest();
  const got = Buffer.from(header.slice(7), "hex");
  return got.length === expected.length && timingSafeEqual(got, expected);
}

function readBody(req: IncomingMessage): Promise<Buffer> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
    req.on("data", (c) => chunks.push(c));
    req.on("end", () => resolve(Buffer.concat(chunks)));
    req.on("error", reject);
  });
}

function dedupe(key: string): boolean {
  if (seen.has(key)) return true;
  seen.add(key);
  return false;
}

const server = createServer(async (req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse) => {
  const url = new URL(req.url ?? "/", "http://localhost");
  if (req.method === "GET" && url.pathname === "/webhooks/instagram") {
    const mode = url.searchParams.get("hub.mode");
    const token = url.searchParams.get("hub.verify_token");
    const challenge = url.searchParams.get("hub.challenge") ?? "";
    if (mode === "subscribe" && token && token === VERIFY_TOKEN) {
      res.writeHead(200, { "Content-Type": "text/plain" });
      res.end(challenge);
    } else {
      res.writeHead(403);
      res.end();
    }
    return;
  }
  if (req.method === "POST" && url.pathname === "/webhooks/instagram") {
    const raw = await readBody(req);
    if (!validSignature(raw, req.headers["x-hub-signature-256"] as string | undefined)) {
      res.writeHead(401);
      res.end();
      return;
    }
    res.writeHead(200); // ack fast, process async
    res.end();
    try {
      const body = JSON.parse(raw.toString("utf8")) as {
        object: string;
        entry: Array<{ id: string; time: number; changes?: Array<{ field: string; value: { id?: string } }>; messaging?: Array<{ sender?: { id: string }; message?: { mid?: string; text?: string } }> }>;
      };
      for (const entry of body.entry ?? []) {
        for (const change of entry.changes ?? []) {
          const key = `${change.field}:${change.value?.id}`;
          if (dedupe(key)) continue;
          console.log("change:", change.field, JSON.stringify(change.value));
          // TODO: enqueue → hide/comment-reply/mention pipeline
        }
        for (const msg of entry.messaging ?? []) {
          const key = `msg:${msg.message?.mid}`;
          if (!msg.message?.mid || dedupe(key)) continue;
          console.log("message from", msg.sender?.id, ":", msg.message.text);
          // TODO: enqueue → DM bot reply via POST /{ig-user-id}/messages
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("bad webhook body:", e);
    }
    return;
  }
  res.writeHead(404);
  res.end();
});

server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT ?? 3000), () =>
  console.log(`webhook listening on :${process.env.PORT ?? 3000}/webhooks/instagram`),
);


===== FILE: examples/fetch-insights.py =====

"""Fetch account insights and media insights from the Instagram Graph API.
Generated: 2026-10-13
Env: IG_USER_ID, ACCESS_TOKEN (Page token), GRAPH_HOST, GRAPH_VERSION, MEDIA_ID (optional)
Run: python fetch-insights.py
"""
import json
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from lib import IG_USER_ID, gget


def main():
    account = gget(f"/{IG_USER_ID}/insights",
                   {"metric": "reach,views,accounts_engaged", "period": "day"})
    print("Account insights:", json.dumps(account["data"], indent=2))

    media_id = os.environ.get("MEDIA_ID")
    if media_id:
        media = gget(f"/{media_id}/insights",
                     {"metric": "views,reach,saved,shares"})
        print("Media insights:", json.dumps(media["data"], indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


===== FILE: examples/lib.py =====

"""Minimal Graph client shared by examples/ (requires: pip install requests).

Env: GRAPH_HOST (default https://graph.facebook.com), GRAPH_VERSION (default v25.0),
     IG_USER_ID, ACCESS_TOKEN
"""
import os
import random
import time

import requests

BASE = f"{os.environ.get('GRAPH_HOST', 'https://graph.facebook.com')}/{os.environ.get('GRAPH_VERSION', 'v25.0')}"
TOKEN = os.environ.get("ACCESS_TOKEN", "")
IG_USER_ID = os.environ.get("IG_USER_ID", "")


class GraphError(RuntimeError):
    def __init__(self, method, path, error, status):
        self.code = (error or {}).get("code")
        self.subcode = (error or {}).get("error_subcode")
        self.fbtrace_id = (error or {}).get("fbtrace_id")
        super().__init__(f"{method} {path} -> {self.code}: {(error or {}).get('message', status)}")


def gget(path, params=None):
    r = requests.get(f"{BASE}{path}", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {TOKEN}"},
                     params=params or {}, timeout=30)
    data = r.json()
    if r.status_code != 200:
        raise GraphError("GET", path, data.get("error"), r.status_code)
    return data


def gpost(path, data=None):
    payload = dict(data or {})
    payload["access_token"] = TOKEN
    r = requests.post(f"{BASE}{path}", data=payload, timeout=60)
    body = r.json()
    if r.status_code != 200:
        raise GraphError("POST", path, body.get("error"), r.status_code)
    return body


def gpost_json(path, payload):
    r = requests.post(f"{BASE}{path}", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {TOKEN}"},
                      json=payload, timeout=30)
    body = r.json()
    if r.status_code != 200:
        raise GraphError("POST", path, body.get("error"), r.status_code)
    return body


RETRYABLE = {1, 2, 4, 17, 32}


def with_retry(fn, tries=5):
    delay = 1.0
    for i in range(tries):
        try:
            return fn()
        except GraphError as e:
            if i == tries - 1 or (e.code is not None and e.code not in RETRYABLE):
                raise
            time.sleep(delay + random.uniform(0, 0.25))
            delay *= 2


===== FILE: examples/publish-photo.py =====

"""Publish a single photo via the Graph API (two-step flow).
Generated: 2026-10-13
Env: IG_USER_ID, ACCESS_TOKEN (Page token), GRAPH_HOST, GRAPH_VERSION, IMAGE_URL, CAPTION
Run: python publish-photo.py
"""
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from lib import IG_USER_ID, gpost


def main():
    container = gpost(f"/{IG_USER_ID}/media", {
        "image_url": os.environ.get("IMAGE_URL", "https://example.com/photo.jpg"),
        "caption": os.environ.get("CAPTION", "Hello from the API #launch"),
    })
    print("Container:", container["id"])

    published = gpost(f"/{IG_USER_ID}/media_publish", {"creation_id": container["id"]})
    print("Published media ID:", published["id"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


===== FILE: examples/publish-reel.py =====

"""Publish a Reel: create a REELS container, poll until FINISHED, then publish.
Generated: 2026-10-13
Env: IG_USER_ID, ACCESS_TOKEN (Page token), GRAPH_HOST, GRAPH_VERSION, VIDEO_URL, CAPTION
Run: python publish-reel.py
"""
import os
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from lib import IG_USER_ID, gget, gpost


def wait_finished(container_id, tries=120):
    for _ in range(tries):
        s = gget(f"/{container_id}", {"fields": "status_code,status"})
        print("Status:", s["status_code"])
        if s["status_code"] == "FINISHED":
            return
        if s["status_code"] in ("ERROR", "EXPIRED"):
            raise RuntimeError(f"Container {s['status_code']}: {s.get('status', 'unknown')}")
        time.sleep(5)
    raise TimeoutError("timed out waiting for FINISHED")


def main():
    container = gpost(f"/{IG_USER_ID}/media", {
        "media_type": "REELS",
        "video_url": os.environ.get("VIDEO_URL", "https://example.com/reel.mp4"),
        "caption": os.environ.get("CAPTION", "New reel"),
        "share_to_feed": "true",
    })
    print("Container:", container["id"])
    wait_finished(container["id"])
    published = gpost(f"/{IG_USER_ID}/media_publish", {"creation_id": container["id"]})
    print("Published Reel media ID:", published["id"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


===== FILE: examples/reply-to-comment.py =====

"""Reply to an Instagram comment via the Graph API.
Generated: 2026-10-13
Env: ACCESS_TOKEN (Page token), GRAPH_HOST, GRAPH_VERSION, COMMENT_ID, MESSAGE
Run: python reply-to-comment.py
"""

import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from lib import gpost


def main():
    comment_id = os.environ.get("COMMENT_ID", "178700001")
    reply = gpost(f"/{comment_id}/replies", {
        "message": os.environ.get("MESSAGE", "Thanks! More coming Friday."),
    })
    print("Reply comment ID:", reply["id"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


===== FILE: examples/webhook-handler.py =====

"""Instagram webhook receiver: verification (GET) + signed event intake (POST).
Generated: 2026-10-13
Env: PORT (default 3000), WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN, APP_SECRET
Run: python webhook-handler.py  (expose via ngrok/cloudflared for Meta to reach it)

Stdlib only — no framework dependency.
"""
import hashlib
import hmac
import json
import os
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
from urllib.parse import urlparse, parse_qs

VERIFY_TOKEN = os.environ.get("WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN", "")
APP_SECRET = os.environ.get("APP_SECRET", "")
SEEN = set()  # replace with Redis/DB in production


def valid_signature(raw: bytes, header: str) -> bool:
    if not header.startswith("sha256=") or not APP_SECRET:
        return False
    expected = hmac.new(APP_SECRET.encode(), raw, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(expected, header.removeprefix("sha256="))


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        url = urlparse(self.path)
        if url.path != "/webhooks/instagram":
            return self.send_response(404), self.end_headers()
        q = parse_qs(url.query)
        if (q.get("hub.mode", [""])[0] == "subscribe"
                and q.get("hub.verify_token", [""])[0] == VERIFY_TOKEN
                and VERIFY_TOKEN):
            body = q.get("hub.challenge", [""])[0].encode()
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)
        else:
            self.send_response(403)
            self.end_headers()

    def do_POST(self):
        url = urlparse(self.path)
        if url.path != "/webhooks/instagram":
            return self.send_response(404), self.end_headers()
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
        raw = self.rfile.read(length)
        if not valid_signature(raw, self.headers.get("X-Hub-Signature-256", "")):
            self.send_response(401)
            return self.end_headers()
        self.send_response(200)  # ack fast, process async
        self.end_headers()
        try:
            body = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
        except ValueError as e:
            print("bad webhook body:", e)
            return
        for entry in body.get("entry", []):
            for change in entry.get("changes", []) or []:
                key = f"{change.get('field')}:{(change.get('value') or {}).get('id')}"
                if key in SEEN:
                    continue
                SEEN.add(key)
                print("change:", change.get("field"), json.dumps(change.get("value")))
                # TODO: enqueue -> hide/comment-reply/mention pipeline
            for msg in entry.get("messaging", []) or []:
                mid = (msg.get("message") or {}).get("mid")
                if not mid or f"msg:{mid}" in SEEN:
                    continue
                SEEN.add(f"msg:{mid}")
                print("message from", (msg.get("sender") or {}).get("id"),
                      ":", (msg.get("message") or {}).get("text"))
                # TODO: enqueue -> DM bot reply via POST /{ig-user-id}/messages

    def log_message(self, *args):
        pass


if __name__ == "__main__":
    port = int(os.environ.get("PORT", "3000"))
    print(f"webhook listening on :{port}/webhooks/instagram")
    HTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", port), Handler).serve_forever()
